notes: Saved 2026-11-14 (Hong Kong; 2026-11-13 23:52 UTC) in the operator investigation (.superpowers/raw-pages/charming/09-tour-gerd-gere.raw), trimmed with the allow list in docs/operators/charming.md.

The page sells two variants on the same six dates: GERD (11 days, back from Paris) and GERE (12 days, with London). The title says `11/12天 … ~ GERD/E`. One page gives one tour, so the parser takes the longest variant, GERE: its code (the `E` replaces the end of `GERD`, and the table's codes `GERE12E-…` confirm it), its 12 days and its six rows (45498 each, after the early-booking discount; 48498 before). GERD's rows (39898) are left out, so GERD is not listed. Judgment call.
The `Day 10/11 … - GERD` entry (`巴黎 ~ 自由活動 ~ 香港`, GERD's flight home) is tagged with the other variant's code and left out; 11 headings remain for 12 days because `Day 11/12` covers the night flight.
`羅馬(鬥獸場 ~ 許願池)` has a `~` inside its brackets; the heading is kept as the page gives it.
startPoint and endPoint are `香港` (day 1's first place, the last day's last place): Hong Kong.

Stops are as they come out with places/data.json as it stood on 2026-11-14: `博訥/迪戎` gives 波本 (Beaune, by its alias 博訥) only, because `迪戎` (Dijon; the list has 第戎) is missing; `梵蒂崗` (the list has 梵蒂岡), `貝林佐納` (Bellinzona) and `英高柏` (Engelberg) are real places missing from the list, so the route lacks them. 溫莎 comes from `自費：溫莎古堡半日遊`, an optional excursion, by core's contained-name rule.
